description.value: Brunch is a Mexican-inspired brunch restaurant in Downtown Vancouver's Granville Street corridor, specializing in dishes like chilaquiles, enchiladas suizas, and eggs Benedict made with Mexican-sourced flavors and techniques. The restaurant offers a warm dine-in experience alongside takeout and delivery, making it a flexible stop for those exploring the downtown core. Vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free accommodations are available on request from staff.
